collection.title: Vauxhall Arena 1997 to 2001 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Vauxhall Arena 1997 to 2001 model which requires a 20" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
